source.author: verg
source.text: Surgit et aetherii spectans orientia solis lumina rite cavis undam de flumine palmis sustinet ac talis effundit ad aethera voces:
source.text_original: Surgit et aetherii spectans orientia solis / lumina rite cavis undam de flumine palmis / sustinet ac talis effundit ad aethera voces: /
source.text_english: He rises, and gazing at the rising lights of the heavenly sun, duly with hollow palms he catches water from the river and pours forth such words to the sky:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces:
reuse.text_original: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati / intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces: /
reuse.text_english: But the father of the Scythian son was not likewise fearless amid the danger, and the Sun pours forth such words from his heart:
